name: Sunvim Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Sunvim Group Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells home textile products in China, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Australia, the Middle East. The company offers home textile products comprising towels, bedding, and decorative fabrics. It also provides coating materials, chemical, thermoelectric, electric machine, and other products. The company is involved in real estate, heat and electricity, motor, and other industries, as well as production, sales and service of industrial water and drinking water. Sunvim Group Co.,Ltd sells its products through direct sales and online channels. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Gaomi, China.
